input: I want further opportunities for people to request projects tools topics etc through the repo or website and for it to get added to the dev queue and also to scan it for malicious prompt injection before working on it.
errors: First screen draft held the owner's own tracker issue for merely naming CLAUDE.md and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; split mention (caution) from action (hold) and pinned it with a test.

deviations.did: Shipped the screen, intake, validator, site forms and edge types outside CODEOWNERS paths.
